text:
maya: :rotating_light: seeing widespread provisioning failures in na-east1 starting ~08:12 UTC. multiple GPU allocs stuck PENDING, control-plane /api/auth returning 502 and console 504 when opening node groups. raising incident and tagging oncall.
ops-sre: copying — I'm seeing provisioner errors: "lease: failed to acquire quota" and provisioner queue depth spiking. hitting controlplane 5xx at ~80% over 5m. @infra-bot can you dump cluster health?
oncall-bot: (bot) Incident created: INC-2023456. Pager notified.
infra-bot: (bot) cluster health: na-east1-gpupool: Ready 3/12, Provisioning 6/12, Failed 3/12. controlplane-api: 5xx rate 85% (5m). recent events: network flaps -> db replica lag. details: https://status.internal/na-east1
sam: quick check — are auth failures coming from authz gateway or token service? logs show repeated "invalid_jwt" and "session not found".
dinesh: joining — token-service in na-east1-controlplane is crashlooping due to DB timeouts. DB replica lag ~30s after network hiccup, token-service fails that break config-rollout because lock manager uses same DB. rollouts blocked.
elaine: we should shift traffic off na-east1 while we stabilize. propose weights: na-east1 0.2, na-west2 0.4, sfo1 0.4. ops-sre agree?
ops-sre: initiating gradual traffic shift via routing API. CLI commands I'm running:
```
redwood route update --region na-east1 --weight 0.2
redwood route update --region na-west2 --weight 0.4
redwood route update --region sfo1 --weight 0.4
```
watching for cold-cache impact and KV cache-miss related latency.
kevin: flag — dedicated GPU customers in na-east1 may hit capacity shortfall if we evacuate too aggressively. need customer comms and potential burst allocations in other regions. tagging sales & cs.
maya: drafting customer notice in #customer-notify: "We are experiencing degraded control plane in na-east1 that impacts console and provisioning. Traffic is being shifted while we stabilize. ETA 30-60m; we'll follow up with post-incident details."
infra-bot: (bot) deploy-bot: config-rollout lock held by rollout/2023456 since 2023-11-05T08:10:12Z. manual override at /admin/rollout requires admin approval.
ryan: I can release the lock but want minimal blast radius. what's the expected impact? dinesh?
dinesh: if we release lock and restart token-service, auth should recover. risk: some in-flight sessions get 401s and will need reauth, but overall recovery faster. I'm fine with restart.
ops-sre: escalated to P1, establishing bridge +1 555 0101. ops taking lead.
sam: after restart, monitor token-error-rate, controlplane-5xx, provisioner-queue-depth, and KV cache hit ratio.
maya: performing restart now: `kubectl -n controlplane rollout restart deploy/token-service --context=na-east1`
ops-sre: token-service pods redeployed, liveness passing. controlplane 5xx dropped to ~10% over last 2m.
maya: provisioning backlog decreasing — more nodes entering Ready. console access restoring for many users. keeping traffic shift in place for safety.
kevin: coordinating customer comms and offering credits if SLA impacted. informing account leads.
elaine: immediate action items: keep reduced regional weight for 45m, run postmortem, add automated DB retry/backoff for token-service, implement watchdog to auto-release stale config-rollout locks after a TTL.
maya: incident de-escalating. closing the incident for now — will reopen if any regressions. thanks team :tada:
